text:
emma_sales: Heads up 1: MercuryPay wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Key asks: USB delivery, strict no-call-home, offline license tied to their HSM, and monthly security attestation. Need a short ops checklist + pricing delta.

raj_se: USB delivery ok. Do they want signed incremental patches or full image flashes? They asked for "patches when possible" but left it open.

emma_sales: They wrote: "prefer patch deltas to avoid full re-images; acceptable monthly cadence; emergency hotfixes as full images".

olivia_eng: Technically we can produce delta minibundles for the app/runtime layers. Two constraints: 1) model quant/shape changes -> full image, 2) delta signing pipeline not yet hardened for offline HSM integration. We can support customer-side re-signing (recommended) to avoid legal chain-of-custody work.

carlos_be: For USB artifacts we need clear checksum & verification steps. Suggest zip with `manifest.json`, `sbom.json`, `signature.sig`. Example manifest fields we require: `bundle_version`, `delta_base`, `signed_by`, `sbom_hash`, `hsm_anchor`.

nina_security: On the security questionnaire: short answers \u2014 we never store private keys; we support FIPS-validated signing. For monthly attestations we can provide signed SHA256 digests and a statement of build environment. If they want us to plug into their HSM to produce final signatures that's a legal+ops heavy path and will require SC/contract changes.

tara_ops: Operational notes:
- We can generate a zero-telemetry build using `--no-telemetry` but QA cycles + manual sign-off add ~4 business days.
- USB burn + checksum verification doc will be provided.
- We recommend a local repo mirror approach for anything > 3 updates; USB is fine for 1-2 deltas.

ship-bot: pipeline: `artifact-pack` started for `poc/MercuryPay` (job id ap-612345). ETA 2024-07-16T02:15Z.

raj_se: Pricing thoughts: one-off packaging + USB prep = $18k, bench test + SBOM generation = $4k, optional retainer for monthly signed deltas = $3k/mo, emergency full-image hotfix support billed at $6k/event. Will add clause for quantization-driven full-image cases.

emma_sales: Can someone draft a 1-page preflight I can send? Need network exceptions (if any), HSM cert export format, allowable maintenance windows, and acceptance tests.

olivia_eng: Draft checklist below you can copy: 
- HSM: provide public cert fingerprint (PEM) and vendor/model + FIPS level
- Delivery: confirm USB courier or local repo; if USB, provide chain-of-custody policy
- Telemetry: confirm `--no-telemetry` required (we won't enable call-home)
- Update cadence: monthly delta (customer requested), emergency hotfix windows TBD
- Acceptance tests: cold-start model load, inference throughput check (p99 latency), and signature verification pass
- Rollback plan: customer must preserve previous full-image snapshot; deltas are not guaranteed to be reversible if model KV formats change

Also sample manifest we will include in each USB bundle:
```
{
  "bundle_version": "2024.07.01",
  "delta_from": "2024.06.01",
  "signed_by": "redwood-release-3",
  "hsm_anchor": "sha256:<fingerprint>",
  "sbom": "sbom-2024.07.01.json"
}
```

nina_security: Addendum: we can provide a signed attestation PDF per release that lists build hash, SBOM digest, and build env snapshot. That satisfies most auditors.

carlos_be: Note on transport: USB vendors sometimes corrupt file attributes. We will include a verification script `verify_bundle.sh` that checks SHA256 and signature and exits non-zero on mismatch.

raj_se: I'll slot this into the SOW: scope, deliverables (USB + docs), pricing line items, retainer, and emergency response SLAs.

emma_sales: Great. I'll send to MercuryPay now and ask for HSM fingerprint + confirmation of monthly cadence. Ping if legal needs to join. :thumbsup:
